verdict.rationale: Incremental rollout is a fair question for a deployment platform like Netlify, but the evidence pack never documents canary, percentage-based, or traffic-splitting rollouts. The cited items cover adjacent controls only: one-click rollback, Deploy Previews, and choosing when to publish, none of which roll out a deployment incrementally to reduce blast radius.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can roll out new deployments incrementally to reduce blast radius
